g.text: Custodians own the graphs. Implementation consumes the specs. Enablement supports both from beneath.
The four ontologies, kept current. Impact-analyzed specs at spec sprint cadence.
Owns the graphs across years. Forward-Deployed Engineers backﬁll missing coverage.
validated specs + impact reports feed implementation
Consume impact-analyzed specs. Write code (or in Stage 4,
write the agents that write code) under the four-ontology gates.
code generation under the spec sprint's direction.
Code merged to master under structural validation. KG Sync updates the Code Ontology on every merge.
Does not author specs, make architecture decisions, or extend the ontology shape.
merge events trigger KG sync; rationalization ﬁndings ﬂow upward
Customization of Breeze.AI / ASIMOV. Initial graph setup. Agent ﬂeet operations. Managed support cadence.
Supports the client's custodians; does not own the graphs. Tiered: Light / Medium / Deep.
